_comment: Template for ~/.claude/settings.json. Replace {CLAUDE_SCRIPTS} with your scripts path and {CLAUDE_HOOKS} with your hooks path. On Windows: C:/Users/<username>/.claude/scripts and C:/Users/<username>/.claude/hooks. v2.0.0 REGISTERS NO UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse or PostToolUse HOOK. Those three were deleted by PRD FR-4 / SRS FR-13 and FR-15; the pipeline is reached only through the six explicit slash commands, and tool-call enforcement is reached only through registered MCP servers. Re-adding any of them here silently undoes that migration on every machine bootstrapped from this file, which is why tests/test_settings_template_has_no_deleted_hooks.py fails if one returns.
